title: I made my first open world 3JS game with Codex!
author: GlitteringJob9248
selftext:
Introducing Lunar Rover: drive your rover across a tiny spherical Moon, survive the dark side on battery power, chase the sunrise, discover historic landing sites, and slowly scan the whole lunar surface.

Built with Three.js, WebGL shaders, procedural terrain, WebAudio, and yes, I even wrote the soundtrack in JavaScript 😛

Copilot with Codex GPT 5.5 Extra High lost productivity starting last night 😛

I spent my whole day on this today probobly should go back and do some real work 😛....

Here is how I made it:  
game was simple, just vibing with gpt 5.5.

then it is continues fin turning.. for a long time.. updating the modal and shaders..

then when it comes to music, I use pure JS to render it, use some song as background and have claude and also gpt to give me some variations, then I end up on this one after i hand tunned it a bit.

I like it a lot!! i made so much progress into this enjoy! haha. need some sleep right now

Game here: [https://www.aigameshare.com/games/lunar-rover](https://www.aigameshare.com/games/lunar-rover?play=1&mode=fullscreen)
